# Mousa Glass

> Mousa Glass is an Arabic, right-to-left storefront for glass accessories serving Hurghada and the Red Sea area in Egypt.

## Public pages

- [Home](/): Store overview and featured products.
- [Shop](/shop): Searchable product catalog.
- [About Mousa](/about): Store overview and service approach.
- [Contact](/contact): Phone numbers, WhatsApp, service area, and opening hours.
- [Delivery and returns](/delivery&returns): How delivery, order confirmation, and issue review work.
- [FAQ](/faq): Answers to common ordering and product-selection questions.
